svg.title: Tech stack
svg.desc: Languages: TypeScript, Python, Java, Kotlin, SQL, C. Web: React, Next.js, Node.js, Express, Fastify, Tailwind. Data: PostgreSQL, pgvector, Redis, BullMQ, Supabase, SQLite, Firebase. AI: OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, Ollama, RAG, Speech-to-text, MCP, n8n. Infra: Docker, GitHub Actions, Cloudflare, Vercel, Raspberry Pi, Linux.
